However, it is to be noted here that the claim petition was initially dismissed on 10.05.2005 and against the said judgment and award, the claimant has approached this court in M.F.A.No.No.6299/2012 and matter came to be remanded.

sentences.text: Once the insured plays fraud, admits liability with the sole object of foisting liability on the insurance company, though in fact he knew that it is not true, liability of the insurance company to indemnify such insured ceases.

Therefore, there is no obligation on the part of the insurance company to indemnify the insured even though he has taken the policy and the statute mandates that the insurance company has to indemnify the insured and pay compensation to third party.

When fraud is established from the material on record,
such statutory obligation stands discharged.
- There is no third party liability on the part of the insurance company to pay compensation to the claimants.

This amount is awarded in order to see that in future such false defences are not filed before Court,
judicial process is not abused.
Therefore, it is only the 1st Respondent/Owner who is liable to pay the amount."
The division bench of this court has clearly observed that when fraud is established from material on record then statutory obligation under policy stands discharged.
Further, it is observed that the compensation awarded against the owner is to see that in future such false claims are not filed before the court and the judicial process is not abused.
The said principles are directly applicable to the facts and circumstances of the case in hand.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
No doubt the respondent No.1 was prosecuted and he pleaded guilty and was convicted, but on perusal of Ex.P3 - the vehicle seizure mahazar, it is evident that no damages were noticed on the vehicle.
If the vehicle skidded on a public road, it should have suffered damages,
but no such damages are forthcoming.
Even the IMV Inspector report is not produced by the claimant to show that the vehicle did suffer damages.
All these aspects are required to be explained by the claimant, but no such evidence is forthcoming and the conduct of respondent No.1 and the delay in lodging the complaint clearly establish that it is a false claim made in order to get the benefit out of the injuries sustained somewhere else.

the sole object of getting compensation to the claimants as it is the insurance company which will pay, and not the owner.
Though admission is the best piece of evidence, it cannot be accepted a gospel truth.
The Court can insist on proof of facts, if the admission is not satisfactory.
In the instant case, since the court was not satisfied, it wanted the claimants to prove their case independently.
